title: Ondansetron Unit Rate on Outpatient Surgery Accounts — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Contract rate schedule.** For ondansetron (code J2405 under revenue code 0636) on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), when its small-item value is figured on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Payer class | Rate per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 1.90 USD |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 1.65 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

Ondansetron is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Hypothetical footnote: 6 units with charges of 30.00 are valued at 11.40 on a Commercial PPO Claim and at 9.90 on a Commercial HMO Claim; with charges of 8.00 they are valued at 8.00.
